topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: The sky's heavy, like it's been holding more than just clouds lately. I heard the party, the one meant to bring a smile, won't be happening. Strange, how the news can feel like the first chill of autumn, even when the sun is bright and warm. The ground's been good this year, but some things, they just don’t grow as we hope. I keep thinking, maybe I should have planted a few extra seeds, done something different. But what's done is done, and the earth won’t lie fallow forever. We'll see what the next harvest brings, and maybe it’ll be a better turn of the wheel.
